topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I stumbled upon the stack of papers tucked away in the back of the drawer, wrapped in faded blue ribbon. As I unfolded each page, my name leapt from the lines, woven into a story I didn’t know I was part of. It was a world where our moments, both big and small, took on a new life, transformed by his imagination. I couldn’t help but smile at the way he captured our early mornings and late night talks, the way he painted our home with words that felt like a warm embrace. I found myself lost in those pages, grateful for every line.
